name: RegentFX Fast Boot
author: omp
description: Conditional boot-stall fix for RegentFX. Requires RegentFXFastBoot to load BEFORE RegentFX: place it above RegentFX in the game's mod list. In that order it skips RegentFX's synchronous scene preload (only when RegentFX's own PreloadEffects setting is on) and re-warms the same scene cache one scene per frame from the live NGame during menu idle time. If RegentFX initializes first, this launch is late-order: nothing is suppressed or warmed, and the log says so. First-combat warmth depends on timing and is not guaranteed. Requires RegentFX to be installed; BaseLib is no longer required.
